text:
anna_dev: Heads-up — starting planning for migrating /v1 -> /v2 for the realtime /generate endpoint. Proposal: deploy a compat-adapter at the edge that translates v1 request/response shapes to v2, plus phased telemetry and a 90-day grace period. want a quick sync on tradeoffs.

tyler_platform: ack. rough question — are we changing auth or just response envelope? how invasive will the adapter be?

anna_dev: no auth changes. primary differences are response envelope (structured metadata added) and a new `usage.signature` field we want to surface. adapter should be lightweight: map envelope fields, synthesize usage.signature when possible, and forward untouched otherwise. fallback policy if mapping fails -> return v1-like error.

mika_ml: for telemetry we'll need at least: incoming token_count, outgoing token_count, latency_ms, mapping_failures, model_variant, and customer_tier. sample event stub:
```
{
  "event":"compat_adapter.request",
  "ts":1729502461000,
  "customer_id":"acct_123",
  "latency_ms":82,
  "in_tokens":12,
  "out_tokens":48,
  "mapping_error":null,
  "model":"redwood-v2-small"
}
```
I'll add a light-weight schema in the telemetry repo.

sanjay_sre: note: Dedicated + Private customers often disable auto-updates. Private in particular may not want adapter injected. we should have cluster-level opt-in and a per-tenant "compat-mode" flag. Also, ensure adapter doesn't add blocking sync calls — must be async/stream-safe.

kate_pm: PM ask: can we publish a migration guide + deprecation timeline? also: add deprecation banner in Console and a suggested migration checklist. we need text for customer comms.

tyler_platform: suggest rollout gates: canary (1% traffic) -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. rollback if error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 10m. also add a health metric: mapping_failure_rate < 0.1%.

anna_dev: agree. i'll own the adapter PR. action items: anna = adapter + runbook; mika = telemetry schema + dashboards; tyler = rollout scripts & gate enforcement; sanjay = opt-in flag + resource limits; kate = migration docs + customer comms.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: scheduled canary window: 2025-05-10T15:00:00Z (1h) — ensure on-call available.

anna_dev: last note — keep adapter op-path monotonic: dont change semantics for existing v1 customers. any behavior that is ambiguous should surface as a mapping_failure event rather than changing response text. we'll iterate after canary.

tyler_platform: cool. i'll open the rollout checklist and link it here when ready. :thumbsup:

sanjay_sre: i'll add a smoke test that hits edge adapter and validates envelope fields and signature synthesis.

kate_pm: i'll draft mail + console banner copy and share tomorrow.
